body_html:
@JennBinis Yes but the feds holding back on purse strings or dangling massive carrots during an economic crisis can quickly nationalize what were once federated standards.

....and while I have never hated ccss I have always found folks rewriting history to make the drafting and approval sound way more inclusive and open to the public than what realluy happened.
